1 // bin/phase1.mjs — Wave 4 Phase-1 seam: run the stakes adjudication + Oranges foresight and emit
2 // ONE persisted Phase-1 receipt (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN Wave 4 done-when: "Phase-1 emits a persisted
3 // stakes vector → governor tier, and an Oranges receipt").
4 //
5 // This is the seam the engine (Wave 5+) calls before the verification loop: it adjudicates the
6 // declared stakes into a governor tier (which scales the loop) and runs foresight to re-aim the
7 // research plan, then PERSISTS both as a single durable receipt so the run is replayable and
8 // reviewer-checkable. Persistence is additive: the receipt embeds the RAW declared stakes vector
9 // verbatim (`receipt.stakes.raw`), so a consumer that only knows the declared axes still reads them
10 // after the round-trip — no schema break.
11 //
12 // The write is atomic (temp file + rename) so a crash mid-write can never leave a torn receipt —
13 // the same durability discipline the trio's checkpointing uses. The module is otherwise pure:
14 // `runPhase1` is a deterministic function of its input.
15 
16 import fs from 'node:fs';
17 import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
18 
19 import { adjudicateStakes } from './stakes.mjs';
20 import { runForesight } from './oranges.mjs';
21 
22 export const PHASE1_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;
23 
24 /**
25  * Run the Phase-1 seam over one item.
26  * @param {{ stakes: object, plan: {branches:object[]} }} item
27  *   - `stakes`: the declared stakes vector (see bin/stakes.mjs adjudicateStakes).
28  *   - `plan`:   the research plan to re-aim (see bin/oranges.mjs runForesight).
29  * @returns {{ schema_version:number, tier:string, stakes:object, foresight:object }}
30  */
31 export function runPhase1(item) {
32   if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') {
33     throw new TypeError('runPhase1 requires an item { stakes, plan }');
34   }
35   const stakes = adjudicateStakes(item.stakes ?? {});
36   const foresight = runForesight(item.plan ?? { branches: [] });
37   return {
38     schema_version: PHASE1_SCHEMA_VERSION,
39     tier: stakes.tier, // the governor tier the loop scales by (projection of the stakes vector)
40     stakes, // carries `raw` (the verbatim declared vector) + axis_tiers + overrides
41     foresight, // the Oranges receipt (dropped/reordered + stamp + crit3_satisfied)
42   };
43 }
44 
45 /**
46  * Persist a Phase-1 receipt durably (atomic temp-file + rename).
47  * @param {object} receipt a value from runPhase1
48  * @param {URL|string} file destination
49  */
50 export function persistPhase1(receipt, file) {
51   const dest = file instanceof URL ? fileURLToPath(file) : file;
52   const tmp = `${dest}.tmp`;
53   fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(receipt, null, 2) + '\n');
54   fs.renameSync(tmp, dest); // atomic publish — readers never see a torn file
55 }
56 
57 /**
58  * Load a persisted Phase-1 receipt.
59  * @param {URL|string} file
60  * @returns {object} the parsed receipt
61  */
62 export function loadPhase1(file) {
63   const src = file instanceof URL ? fileURLToPath(file) : file;
64   return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(src, 'utf8'));
65 }
